address: Lancer Square, 28A Kensington Church Street, Kensington, London, W8 4EP, United Kingdom
bio: From its linen canopy to its wooden shelves filled with Greek wines, there’s an inviting rustic-chic vibe to this large Greek restaurant – enhanced by the presence of a homely fireplace. The team know how to put their guests at ease and are happy to tell you the story behind each authentic dish. If you want a taste of proper taramasalata without leaving London, this is one of the best places to be – and the ‘Greek Olive Oil Experience’ is a brilliant way to start. Ensure you save room for the 'karidopita' chocolate and walnut cake with ‘kaimaki’ ice cream....
